python3 << 'EOF'
# Department of Commerce total on-budget + off-budget outlays (in millions)
data = {
    2016: 9162,
    2017: 10303,
    2018: 8561,
    2019: 11326,
    2020: 15918,
    2021: 13135,
    2022: 11734,
    2023: 12045,
    2024: 14831
}

# Extract values and sort
values = sorted(data.values())
print("FY 2016-2024 Department of Commerce outlays (millions of dollars):")
for year, val in sorted(data.items()):
    print(f"  FY {year}: {val}")

print(f"\nSorted values: {values}")
print(f"Number of observations: {len(values)}")

# Calculate Quartile 1 using Tukey exclusive median method
# Step 1: Find the median (Q2)
n = len(values)
sorted_vals = values

# The median is the middle value(s)
if n % 2 == 0:
    median = (sorted_vals[n//2 - 1] + sorted_vals[n//2]) / 2
else:
    median = sorted_vals[n//2]

print(f"Median (Q2): {median}")

# For Tukey exclusive method: exclude the median and split remaining data into halves
if n % 2 == 0:
    # Even n: split into two equal halves
    lower_half = sorted_vals[:n//2]
    upper_half = sorted_vals[n//2:]
else:
    # Odd n: exclude median and split remaining into two halves
    lower_half = sorted_vals[:n//2]
    upper_half = sorted_vals[n//2 + 1:]

print(f"Lower half (excl. median): {lower_half}")
print(f"Upper half (excl. median): {upper_half}")

# Calculate median of lower half = Q1
m = len(lower_half)
if m % 2 == 0:
    Q1 = (lower_half[m//2 - 1] + lower_half[m//2]) / 2
else:
    Q1 = lower_half[m//2]

# Calculate median of upper half = Q3
m_upper = len(upper_half)
if m_upper % 2 == 0:
    Q3 = (upper_half[m_upper//2 - 1] + upper_half[m_upper//2]) / 2
else:
    Q3 = upper_half[m_upper//2]

print(f"\nQ1 (Tukey exclusive): {Q1}")
print(f"Q3 (Tukey exclusive): {Q3}")

# Round to nearest hundredths place
Q1_rounded = round(Q1, 2)
print(f"\nQ1 rounded to nearest hundredths: {Q1_rounded}")
EOF
